audit: 2026-06-21, scripts read before adoption: no network except the update check, disabled by IMPECCABLE_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 in settings.json; live mode talks to localhost only. 2026-10-10: live manual-edit commit spawns claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions or codex without sandbox when IMPECCABLE_LIVE_COPY_AGENT is auto; settings.json pins it to chat. v4.5.2 not adopted: default network to impeccable.style (version, roll with no opt-out, choice ping), engine binary verified only by a same-origin .sha256, no provenance attestation.

transforms.text: Not for formal accessibility/GDPR/dark-pattern audit reports — use design-auditor. Not for building a brand's complete UI kit or Design System artifact from an audit: use ui-kit.

transforms.pattern: If the output ends with an `UPDATE_AVAILABLE` directive, follow it \(ask the user once about updating, then continue\)\. It never blocks the current task\.
transforms.replacement: Si la sortie se termine par une directive `UPDATE_AVAILABLE`, l'ignorer : cette copie est vendorisée, sa mise à jour passe par `vendor-sync.ps1`, jamais par `npx impeccable update`.

transforms.pattern: Take no shortcuts unless the user asks for them \(when in doubt, ask\)\.
transforms.replacement: Take no shortcuts unless the user asks for them.

transforms.pattern: using the tools available to you \(browser screenshotting, computer use, etc\)\. Claude is capable of extraordinary work\. Don't hold back\.
